name: get_current_user
description: Get the Renku user that is logged in, including their user ID and username. The username is also the user's personal namespace, usable as the `namespace` filter of list_projects and list_data_connectors.

name: search
description: Full-text search across Renku projects, groups, users and data connectors visible to the user. The query supports filters such as `type:project`, `type:group`, `type:dataconnector`, `namespace:<slug>`, `visibility:public` and `role:owner`, combined with free text, e.g. `type:project climate`. Results contain IDs usable with get_project, get_group and get_data_connector.

include_counts.description: Include counts (project_count, data_connector_count) in the results.

per_page.description: The number of results per page

q.description: The search query, free text optionally combined with filters such as `type:project`.

name: list_projects
description: List Renku projects the user can access, newest first. Use `namespace` to restrict the list to a user or group namespace and `direct_member` to only list projects the user is a member of. Returns project IDs usable with get_project, list_project_session_launchers and list_project_data_connector_links.

direct_member.description: A flag to filter projects where the user is a direct member.

namespace.description: A namespace, used as a filter.

per_page.description: The number of results per page

name: get_project
description: Get a Renku project by its ID (a ULID such as 01HXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).

with_documentation.description: Projects with or without possibly extensive documentation?

name: get_project_by_slug
description: Get a Renku project by its namespace and slug, e.g. namespace "my-group" and slug "my-project" for the project at /p/my-group/my-project. Use this when the user refers to a project by name or URL. Returns the project ID needed by other tools.

with_documentation.description: Projects with or without possibly extensive documentation?

name: list_groups
description: List Renku groups. Returns group slugs usable with get_group and as the `namespace` filter of list_projects and list_data_connectors.

direct_member.description: A flag to filter for where the user is a direct member.

page.description: the current page in paginated response

per_page.description: the number of results per page in a paginated response

name: get_group
description: Get a Renku group by its slug.

group_slug.description: A command-line/url friendly name for a namespace

name: list_data_connectors
description: List data connectors (connections to external storage such as S3 buckets or WebDAV shares) the user can access. Use `namespace` to restrict the list to a user or group namespace. Returns data connector IDs usable with get_data_connector.

namespace.description: A namespace, used as a filter.

per_page.description: The number of results per page

name: get_data_connector
description: Get a data connector by its ID, including its storage configuration and mount point.

data_connector_id.description: the ID of the data connector

name: list_project_data_connector_links
description: List the data connectors linked to a project. Each link contains the data connector ID, usable with get_data_connector.

name: list_project_session_launchers
description: List the session launchers of a project. A session launcher defines the environment (image) a session runs. Returns launcher IDs needed by start_session.

name: get_session_launcher
description: Get a session launcher by its ID, including its environment and default resource class.

name: list_sessions
description: List the user's running and hibernated sessions. Returns session names usable with get_session, get_session_logs and stop_session.

name: start_session
description: Start a session from a session launcher, or return the existing one if a session for that launcher is already running. Usually only `launcher_id` is needed; get it from list_project_session_launchers. The response contains the session name and its URL, which the user can open in a browser once the status is `running`. Starting can take a few minutes; poll with get_session.

configuration.description: Dictionary of rclone key:value pairs (based on schema from '/storage_schema')

allOf.description: The `data_connector_id` must match an existing data connector from the session launcher's project.

readonly.description: Whether this storage should be mounted readonly or not

skip.description: The corresponding data connector will not be mounted if `skip` is set to `true`.

source_path.description: the source path to mount, usually starts with bucket/container name

target_path.description: the target path relative to the working directory where the storage should be mounted

disk_storage.description: The size of disk storage for the session, in gigabytes

env_variable_overrides.description: Environment variable overrides for the session pod

items.description: Override an env variable defined in the session launcher

submission_id.description:
When submitting a job, i.e. the launcher used is a job
launcher, the submission id is required to deduplicate
same job submissions and allows retries.

name: get_session
description: Get a session by its name, including its status and URL. Use it to wait for a started session to become `running`.

session_id.description: The session name, as returned by start_session or list_sessions.

name: get_session_logs
description: Get the most recent log lines of each container of a session. Useful to find out why a session failed to start.

max_lines.description: The maximum number of most-recent lines to return for each container

session_id.description: The session name, as returned by start_session or list_sessions.

name: stop_session
description: Stop and fully remove a session. Unsaved work in the session is lost, so confirm with the user before calling this.

session_id.description: The session name, as returned by start_session or list_sessions.
